description: God give you joy of the day

participation.context: Opened from Great St Helen's, left the cheese where it was, and named ten o'clock and twelve pence.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave the carrier's word, the cheese, the father's sentence, and the offer of the shop pliers. He kept the rind.
participation.name: Gilbert Shakespeare

relations.note: younger brother, twenty-nine this day, blunt and fond
he brings their father's sentence whole and will not improve it
relations.quote: Father says it's the first thing a player ever held up.

story.body: You named yourself and Great St Helen's, heard the money and the cheese and the thatched frame, and told him the tooth comes out tomorrow at ten for twelve pence. You did not send for the cheese.
